column1: You talk to yourself and, as usual, learn nothing that you didn't already know.
column2: 你自言自語,結果跟往常一樣,學不到什麼新東西。

column1: Hey! One shouldn't attempt to manipulate one's self in a family game.
column2: 喂!這可是闔家歡樂的遊戲,別對自己毛手毛腳的。

column1: Better not. You're likely to get a fur ball.
column2: 還是別了吧,你搞不好會咳出一顆毛球。

column1: The odor you're producing causes you to regret skipping last month's shower.
column2: 你身上飄出的味道,讓你開始後悔上個月沒去洗澡。

column1: You're too busy right now.
column2: 你現在正忙,沒空幹這個。

column1: Better save it for when you're thirsty.
column2: 還是留著吧,等你口渴了再說。

column1: You don't want to do that here.
column2: 你不會想在這裡做這種事的。

column1: You wisely strap on the jetpack to allow your self motion control.
column2: 你很聰明地繫上噴射背包,這樣才能控制自己怎麼動。

column1: The jetpack is useful only in Zero-G situations.
column2: 噴射背包只有在無重力狀態下才派得上用場。

column1: Don't bother. This knife wouldn't cut hot lard.
column2: 別費事了,這把刀連熱豬油都切不動。

column1: Isn't this just the most amazing waste of time?
column2: 這也太浪費時間了吧?

column1: You have to wonder why you're performing such a useless action.
column2: 你不禁納悶,自己幹嘛做這種沒用的事。

column1: You wisely decide this is a serious waste of time and energy.
column2: 你很聰明,一眼就看出這根本是在浪費時間跟力氣。

column1: You ask yourself why you're doing this and are forced to reply that you just don't know.
column2: 你問自己幹嘛這麼做,結果只能老實回答:不知道。

column1: Even for you, this isn't bright.
column2: 就算是你,這樣做也不太聰明。

column1: Thank you for playing Space Quest I. You've been most entertaining.
column2: 感謝你玩《宇宙傳奇I》,你這一路真是笑料十足。

column1: Are you sure you want to restart?
column2: 「你確定要重新開始嗎?」

column1: Memory fragmented.
column2: 記憶體已經支離破碎。

column1: What did you expect them to do, reproduce?
column2: 你還期待「他們」會做什麼,自我複製喔?

column1: You're far too busy for that now.
column2: 你現在忙得很,沒空做這個。

column1: You switch the gadget off to conserve its energy.
column2: 你把小裝置關掉,省點電。

column1: You switch the gadget on.
column2: 你把小裝置打開。

column1: You're far to busy for that now.
column2: 你現在忙得很,沒空做這個。

column1: You scrape that sticky goo from the bottom of the rock.
column2: 你把石頭底部那坨黏糊糊的東西刮下來。

column1: There is nothing you can do to the rock.
column2: 石頭這東西你拿它沒轍。

column1: You've already opened the survival kit and removed its contents.
column2: 你早就打開求生包,把裡面的東西拿出來了。

column1: Upon opening the survival kit you discover a Xenon army knife and a canister of dehydrated water.
column2: 打開求生包,你發現一把氙星軍刀和一罐濃縮水。

column1: You have %d Buckazoid%s
column2: 你有 %d 枚太空幣

column1: Thank you for playing Space Quest I. Too bad you've failed miserably and doomed all of your people to a horrible death at the hands of the Sariens. You quickly glance about the room to see if anyone saw your silly mistake. Better luck next time.
column2: 謝謝你玩《宇宙傳奇I》。只可惜你搞砸了,把全體同胞都害死在沙利安人手上,死狀淒慘。你趕緊瞄一眼四周,看看有沒有人看到你這蠢招。祝你下次好運。

column1: New response: rm%03d %s %s
column2: New response: rm%03d %s %s

column1: Score: %d of %d
column2: 分數: %d / %d

column1: As we join our story, the crew of the Arcada is returning home to Xenon after a successful mission developing the Star Generator. Exhilarated by their accomplishments, they are oblivious to the fact that a sinister craft approaches rapidly from behind.
column2: 話說我們的故事,阿寇達號的組員們才剛成功研發出星辰產生器,正要返航氙星。他們沉浸在成就的喜悅中,渾然不知一艘來意不善的飛船正從後方急速逼近。

column1: ***Thank you for playing Space Quest I. You've been most entertaining.
column2: ***謝謝你玩《宇宙傳奇I》,你的表現真是逗趣。

column1: This is the Data Archive of the Arcada. An interesting array of devices (none of of which you know how to operate) are provided for data study by those with proper clearance.
column2: 這裡是阿寇達號的資料庫。裡頭擺著一整排稀奇古怪的裝置(你半個都不會操作),是提供給持有適當權限的人做資料研究用的。

column1: This is an area of non-descript hallway beneath the Data Archive Storage Cabin.
column2: 這是一段毫無特色的走廊,就在資料庫儲藏艙下方。

column1: The door opens. A man you recognize as one of the head lab scientists stumbles into the room. He appears to be in serious need of some Abdo-Seal abdomen filler!
column2: 門開了。一個你認得是首席實驗室科學家的男人,踉踉蹌蹌地跌進房間裡。他看起來急需來一些「腹腔快補」填充劑!

column1: After only a few steps, he hits the floor with a disconcerting thud.
column2: 才走沒幾步,他就砰的一聲倒在地上,那聲音讓人渾身不對勁。

column1: His lips move.
column2: 他的嘴唇動了動。

column1: Just before his systems cease all functions short of decay, he looks over toward the shelves full of cartridges and utters "%s". With one last gasp, his lifeless form slumps to the floor.
column2: 就在他的身體機能即將完全停擺、只剩腐化一途之前,他望向那排擺滿資料匣的架子,吐出一句「%s」。隨著最後一口氣,他癱軟的身軀滑落在地。

column1: No amount of money will put this man's lungs back in his chest.
column2: 就算有再多錢,也沒辦法把這個人的肺放回他的胸腔裡。

column1: It's a grisly sight. You can't tell where the toasted synthetic fabrics end and the fused organic material begins. There is nothing you can do for him now.
column2: 這畫面實在慘不忍睹。你根本分不清烤焦的合成布料在哪裡結束,融化的血肉又從哪裡開始。你現在幫不了他了。

column1: You see a man dressed in a lab coat. He appears to be ailing in a major way.
column2: 你看到一個穿實驗袍的男人,他的狀況顯然糟透了。

column1: A large laser hole has been burned in his uniform, giving you a nice view of previously unexposed tissue. Struggling painfully, he props himself up on one elbow.
column2: 他的制服上被雷射燒出一個大洞,讓你把原本藏在裡面的組織看得一清二楚。他痛苦地掙扎著,靠一隻手肘撐起身子。

column1: You can do nothing more for the fused flesh-heap of a man.
column2: 這團燒融的血肉,你再也幫不上什麼忙了。

column1: In his present condition (dead) he can't make any use of the data cartridge.
column2: 以他現在的狀態(死人一個),資料匣對他一點用也沒有。

column1: If you give the keycard to the dead scientist, you won't be able to use the special elevators.
column2: 把磁卡留給這個已經死掉的科學家,你就沒辦法用那些特殊電梯了。

column1: The widget apparently has no power to raise the dead.
column2: 這個小裝置顯然沒有起死回生的能耐。

column1: The handy dandy translation gadget will not enable you to communicate with the dead.
column2: 這台方便好用的翻譯機,可沒辦法讓你跟死人溝通。

column1: His audible forms of communication will be limited to what he can convey through the venting of bodily gases.
column2: 他現在唯一能發出的聲音,大概就只剩排氣了。

column1: He didn't smell all that great when he was alive.
column2: 他活著的時候,味道也沒多好聞。

column1: The smell of freshly sheared copper fills the air around the damaged scientist.
column2: 這位科學家的殘骸周圍,瀰漫著一股剛削下來的銅腥味。

column1: You wouldn't want to do that. Trust me.
column2: 你不會想做那種事的,相信我。

column1: This is a Model DX Cartridge Retrieval Unit. Its function is to retrieve and return cartridges from and to the storage unit. It is currently %s.
column2: 這是一台 DX 型資料匣取存裝置,功能是從儲存單元存取資料匣。它目前的狀態是 %s。

column1: You can't reach it. Even if you did, the pinchers look quite nasty.
column2: 你搆不到它。就算搆得到,那對夾爪看起來也挺兇的。

column1: It doesn't respond to human voice commands. It only works through the data archive console.
column2: 它不理會人類的語音指令,只能透過資料庫控制台操作。

column1: I wouldn't be violating his airspace if I were you.
column2: 換作是我,可不會靠他那麼近。

column1: You figure the robot probably works for batteries.
column2: 你猜這台機器人大概是靠電池運作的。

column1: You decide that the cartridge is too important to give back to the robot.
column2: 你認定這個資料匣太重要了,不能還給機器人。

column1: You see no slot on the robot that would fit the keycard.
column2: 你在這台機器人身上找不到能插磁卡的插槽。

column1: The widget, being magnetic, sticks to the robot's outer casing. You remove it again with some difficulty.
column2: 這個小裝置本身有磁性,一下就吸在機器人外殼上,你費了好一番功夫才把它拔下來。

column1: Since the robot does not speak, the translator has nothing to translate.
column2: 這台機器人根本不會說話,翻譯機也沒東西可翻。

column1: You can see a well-lit room above.
column2: 你能看到上面有個燈火通明的房間。

column1: You seem to be on the wrong level to do that.
column2: 你現在好像不在對的樓層,做不了這件事。

column1: You need to go to the top level.
column2: 你得先上到最頂層。

column1: You're currently loitering on one of the upper deck hallways aboard the Starship Arcada.
column2: 你目前在阿寇達號星艦的上層甲板走廊間閒晃。

column1: You frisk the scorched body. Other than carbonized materials, your search reveals nothing. Boy, I hope this isn't becoming a new hobby.
column2: 你搜了搜這具燒焦的屍體。除了碳化物之外什麼都沒搜到。老天,希望這不會變成你的新嗜好。

column1: You have just stumbled into a small, dark, and very cluttered utility closet. Many things fall and most of them land on you. It doesn't say much for your cleaning prowess.
column2: 你一頭撞進一間又小又暗、亂七八糟的雜物間。一堆東西掉了下來,大部分還砸到你身上。看來你打掃的功力也沒多好。

column1: You're startled by the sound of an alarm. Breaking through it, the intercom crackles with the frightened voice of a technician shouting that the Arcada has been boarded by unknown intruders. The transmission ends abruptly in a soundstorm of white noise, soon overtaken by the cold din of silence.
column2: 一陣警報聲把你嚇了一跳。廣播系統劈哩啪啦地響起,傳來一名技師驚慌的聲音,大喊阿寇達號已經被不明入侵者攻佔。通話突然被一陣雜訊風暴打斷,隨後只剩下一片冷冽的死寂。

column1: You hear the overly cheerful voice of the ship's computer say: "Destruct sequence is engaged! %d minutes till detonation."
column2: 你聽見艦上電腦用過分歡快的語氣說道:「自毀程序已啟動!還有 %d 分鐘就會引爆。」

column1: The light is off. Were it on, you'd notice something called illumination.
column2: 燈是關著的。要是開著,你就會注意到一種叫做「照明」的東西。

column1: The sign would yield no smell even if you did have the energy to find a step ladder (which you don't).
column2: 就算你有力氣去找個梯子(其實你沒有),這塊牌子聞起來也不會有什麼味道。

column1: This is Stuart, one of your crewmates. He appears to be non-functional. You used to kid him about it when he was alive but now it's true.
column2: 這是史都華,你的組員之一。他現在看起來已經「當機」了。他活著的時候你老拿這個梗虧他,現在倒是真的成真了。

column1: You have to come out of the closet first.
column2: 你得先走出這間儲藏室才行。

column1: Though you look like a cartoon character, you're not Stretchman.
column2: 雖然你看起來像卡通人物,但你可不是什麼「橡皮人」。

column1: Funny, no response.
column2: 奇怪,沒反應。

column1: On second thought, maybe you shouldn't wipe your nose on Stuart's clothes.
column2: 想想還是算了,你大概不該拿史都華的衣服來擦鼻涕。

column1: Oh, that's really sick. You really should seek professional help.
column2: 喔,這也太噁心了。你真的該去看醫生了。

column1: It's unlikely Stuart will be spending any money in the forseeable future.
column2: 短期內史都華大概不會花什麼錢了。

column1: Stuart was never much help to you, but now he's ignoring you entirely.
column2: 史都華以前就幫不了你什麼忙,現在更是完全不理你了。

column1: Stuart doesn't plan to use one of the special elevators anytime soon.
column2: 史都華短期內應該不會用到那些特殊電梯了。

column1: You wave the widget over Stuart's body. He's still dead.
column2: 你拿小裝置在史都華的屍體上晃了晃。他還是死的。

column1: Even using the translator gadget, you can't communicate with Stuart. He's still dead.
column2: 就算用了翻譯機,你也沒辦法跟史都華溝通。他還是死的。

column1: This is an elevator to one of the lower levels.
column2: 這是一部通往下層樓的電梯。

column1: Pressing your nose to the elevator door merely serves to cool off your nostril hairs. The door has no fragrance.
column2: 把鼻子貼在電梯門上,頂多只能讓你的鼻毛涼快一下。這扇門沒什麼味道。

column1: People are going to start wondering about you if you keep applying your tongue to unusual places.
column2: 你再這樣到處舔奇怪的地方,大家真的會開始懷疑你有問題。

column1: Nothing is visible because of the darkness in here. It's one of the reasons that this is your favorite room aboard the Arcada.
column2: 這裡黑得什麼都看不見,這也是你最愛阿寇達號這個房間的原因之一。

column1: This is the access device to your favorite area of the ship - the closet.
column2: 這是通往你在艦上最愛地點——儲藏室——的出入裝置。

column1: The light's flashing. Hmm, let's see...That seems to ring a distant bell. Oh yeah, now you remember! It means that all living things now aboard the ship could die due to some disastrous situation that currently exists. Whatever the case, some personal hide preservation is in order.
column2: 燈在閃。嗯,讓我想想……好像有點印象。對了,你想起來了!這代表艦上目前發生了某種災難,所有活著的東西都可能因此喪命。不管怎樣,現在該做的是先保住自己這條命。

column1: Since the sign is recessed into the wall you can do nothing with it. A nice, distinct hand print now remains on the alert sign.
column2: 這塊牌子是嵌進牆裡的,你拿它沒轍。倒是警示牌上,現在留下了一個清清楚楚的手印。

column1: You take a whiff and notice a smell common to electronics which haven't had power applied to them in a quite a while.
column2: 你聞了一下,聞到一股很久沒通電的電子產品常有的味道。

column1: Boy, was that a bad idea. Your tongue now bears the residue left behind by adventurers who, like yourself, have shown a need to press various and sundry organs against the sign.
column2: 老天,這下慘了。你的舌頭上現在沾滿了殘留物——那些跟你一樣,忍不住要拿各種器官去貼這塊牌子的冒險者留下的痕跡。

column1: You search Jerry's body and find %s
column2: 你搜了傑瑞的屍體,找到 %s

column1: He smells like Jerry.
column2: 他聞起來就像傑瑞。

column1: I don't think you really want to taste Jerry. But then, who knows?
column2: 我看你應該不會真想嚐嚐傑瑞的味道吧。不過,誰知道呢?

column1: Jerry won't be needing any cash soon
column2: 傑瑞短時間內應該用不到什麼現金

column1: If Jerry ever knew how to read this cartridge, he's not telling now.
column2: 就算傑瑞以前知道怎麼讀這個資料匣,他現在也不會說了。

column1: You really shouldn't put the keycard back -- you're going to need it later.
column2: 你真的不該把磁卡放回去——你晚點還用得到。

column1: Jerry is beyond the need for a widget.
column2: 傑瑞已經用不著什麼小裝置了。

column1: Jerry doesn't appear to be saying anything for the translator gadget to translate.
column2: 傑瑞看起來沒說什麼話,翻譯機沒東西可翻。

column1: You can't do that from your current position.
column2: 你現在這個位置做不了這件事。

column1: You can't do that from this level.
column2: 在這層樓,你做不了這件事。

column1: This is an elevator to one of the upper levels.
column2: 這是一部通往上層樓的電梯。

column1: Your search of %s reveals nothing even you'd carry.
column2: 你搜遍了 %s,連你這種什麼都撿的人都找不到半樣東西。

column1: You can't mess with anything that's not on your floor.
column2: 不是你這層樓的東西,你就別亂碰。

column1: Dead people sure are boring!
column2: 死人還真是無聊透頂!

column1: Gee, He doesn't smell bitter, taste him.
column2: 咦,他聞起來不苦耶,嚐嚐看。

column1: Hmmmm, still not bitter, just like you thought.
column2: 嗯……還是不苦,跟你想的一樣。

column1: You owed Dave a couple of Buckazoids, but there's not much point in repaying them now.
column2: 你欠戴夫幾個太空幣,不過現在還他也沒什麼意義了。

column1: Dave seems somehow disinterested in the cartridge.
column2: 戴夫對這個資料匣,似乎完全提不起興趣。

column1: Dave never had a keycard, and he sure doesn't need one now.
column2: 戴夫從來沒有磁卡,現在更是用不著了。
